title: Path-valued adapter keys split on NEWLINES; a comma is an ordinary filename character

incident.mechanism: the adapter's stringList(value, commaSeparated = false) splits on /\r?\n/ by default and only modelCycle, tools and skills pass true. A preflight that split everything on commas was MORE FORGIVING than the real launch: it reported 6/6 while the real dispatch died three times on 'Config overlay not found: /…/base.overlay.yml,/…/engineer.policy.yml'. A gate that models the launch more generously than the launch proves nothing.

trigger: a comma-joined string in a path-valued key versus a comma-joined string in tools
assertion: the path key yields ONE path; tools yields two; and the argv built from it does not fabricate a second --config
